message.text:
q15.

| Table | Struct — path |
| --- | --- |
| `user` | `store.User` — `store/user.go` (line 29) |
| `attachment` | `store.Attachment` — `store/attachment.go` (line 16) |
| `reaction` | `store.Reaction` — `store/reaction.go` (line 7) |

These are plain Go structs rather than ORM-tagged models, so the table binding lives in the hand-written SQL of each database driver rather than in the struct itself. For example, `store/db/sqlite/user.go` inserts into `user`, `store/db/sqlite/attachment.go` and `store/db/postgres/attachment.go` insert into `attachment`, and `store/db/sqlite/reaction.go` and `store/db/postgres/reaction.go` insert into `reaction`; the MySQL driver files under `store/db/mysql/` mirror the same mapping. The API-level `User`, `Attachment`, and `Reaction` types in `proto/gen/api/v1/` are generated protobuf messages, not table models.
